psychological_meaning: Maroon Flush is a sophisticated and intense color, blending the passion of red with the grounded stability of brown. It evokes feelings of confidence, controlled power, and understated elegance. It can also represent ambition and non-conformity, while suggesting a sense of timeless quality and refinement.
